description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingNotDeletableException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when a request to delete a 'Thing' fails due to insufficient permissions. The class includes static methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested builder class for fluent construction.

classes.name: ThingNotDeletableException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class indicating that a 'Thing' could not be deleted due to insufficient permissions. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException. Provides static methods and a nested builder class for construction.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A mutable, thread-unsafe builder class with fluent API to create instances of ThingNotDeletableException. It sets message, description, cause, href, and headers, and builds the exception with contextually appropriate message based on schema version and ThingId.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance initialized with a specific ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a ThingNotDeletableException from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ThingNotDeletableException from a JSON object representing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new Exception instance with updated DittoHeaders, preserving other details.
